sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.event_ticker from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled' and lo.market_ticker like 'KXMLB%-26SEP02%') select substring(f.event_ticker from '-([0-9]{4}[A-Z]+)$') as game, count(distinct f.event_ticker) as distinct_event_tickers, count(*) as markets, string_agg(distinct split_part(f.event_ticker,'-',1), ',') as series_on_this_game, round(sum(coalesce((select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1),0))::numeric,2) as realized from f group by game order by realized asc
